toolchain: OpenJDK 21.0.10, jts-core built by Maven (-DskipTests) or javac --release 8
options: v2 relate and predicates through RelateNG (RelateNG.relate(a, b) and RelateNG.relate(a, b, RelatePredicate.x())); the Geometry methods still default to the old RelateOp (jts.relate unset), which the v1 contract keeps
overlays through OverlayNGRobust.overlay(a, b, op) directly; Geometry.intersection() and friends still default to the legacy OverlayOp unless -Djts.overlay=ng
